title: LedgerEvent
description: One line of the ledger: something that happened, who or what did it, and the hash of the line before.

id.description: The identity of the event. The same thing read twice gives the same id.

type.description: What happened. A new type is added to this list, never used without it.

adapter.description: The adapter that read or received it.

kind.description: observed: read from the team's tools. claimed: sent by a session about itself.

project.description: The project the event belongs to.

actor.description: The team member who did it.

id.description: The identity of the team member.

team.description: The team the event belongs to.

session.description: For an agent: the session the event comes from.

model.description: For an agent: the model ID of the session.

effort.description: For an agent: the effort of the session.

prompt.description: For an agent: the role prompt.

file.description: The file of the role prompt.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content of the file.

rules.description: Version of the rules in force: the commit they ran from.

task.description: The task, as the tracker names it.

change.description: The merge or pull request, as the code host names it.

branch.description: The branch of the change or of the working directory.

requirements.description: IDs of the requirements the event is linked to.

clauses.description: IDs of the clauses of those requirements.

tests.description: Names of the tests that cover them.

level.description: The level of autonomy in force.

data.description: What belongs to this type of event only.

prev.description: SHA-256, in hex, of the bytes of the line before as they stand in the file, without its line break. Null on the first line.

mode.description: trial: the ledger serves observation and does not count as evidence.
